identity.strategy: src- plus the first 16 hexadecimal characters of SHA-256(canonical URL)
identity.canonicalization: WHATWG URL normalization; fragments and common tracking parameters are removed

hashSemantics.identity: hash.value is SHA-256 of the canonical URL and is stable across page associations
hashSemantics.content: check.contentHash remains null until a scheduled or manual source snapshot audit records remote content

checkPolicy.meaning: Registry generation proves declaration and page association, not remote availability or factual correctness
